'''Klaus Röhl''' (12 November 1933 – 3 March 2024) was a German radiochemist and politician. A member of the [[Free Democratic Party (Germany)|Free Democratic Party]], he served in the [[Bundestag]] from 1990 to 1998.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://webarchiv.bundestag.de/archive/2007/0206/mdb/mdb13/bio/R/roehlkl0.html|title=Dr. Klaus Röhl|work=Bundestag|language=German}}</ref>

Röhl died on 3 March 2024, at the age of 90.<ref>{{cite news |last=Martin|first=Ulrike|date=14 March 2024|title=Um die liberale Politik im Osten Deutschlands verdient gemacht|trans-title= |url=https://www.berliner-woche.de/treptow-koepenick/c-leute/um-die-liberale-politik-im-osten-deutschlands-verdient-gemacht_a410262|language=German|work=[[Berliner Woche]]|location= |access-date=19 March 2024}}</ref>
